body:
## What does this PR do?

The Windows gateway launchers (.cmd, .vbs, detached spawn, windowless restart) set `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` but never `PYTHONUTF8=1`. `PYTHONIOENCODING` only covers stdio streams; the gateway's Python 3.11 tree keeps `locale.getpreferredencoding()` at the ANSI code page (cp936 on a zh-CN host), so every `subprocess` reader thread and plugin import that decodes a child's UTF-8 output dies with `UnicodeDecodeError` (#127633) — the reporter captured 245 reader-thread crashes per log, answers rendered twice after client retries, and a follow-up report shows the memory-provider plugin silently failing to import.

`_decode_schtasks_output`'s docstring in the same file already states "the launcher sets `PYTHONUTF8=1`" — the env tuple just never did. This PR makes every launcher surface actually set it, and teaches the `_vbs_identity` verifier to accept the key so freshly installed launchers stay verified instead of reading as drifted.

## Related Issue

Fixes #127633

## Type of Change

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)

## Changes Made

- `hermes_cli/gateway_windows.py`: `_GATEWAY_ENV` exports `("PYTHONUTF8", "1")`, which flows into the .cmd wrapper, the .vbs launcher and the detached-spawn overlay built from it
- `hermes_cli/gateway_windows.py`: `windowless_gateway_restart_spec`'s hardcoded overlay (post-update respawn / runtime start path) also sets `PYTHONUTF8=1` to match `_GATEWAY_ENV`
- `hermes_cli/gateway_runtime_service_identity.py`: `_vbs_identity` whitelists `PYTHONUTF8`; its env-key regex `[A-Z_]+` also rejected digits, so `env.Item("PYTHONUTF8") = "1"` could never parse — widened to `[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*` (whitelist still enumerates exact keys)
- `tests/hermes_cli/test_gateway_windows.py`: both generated launchers export PYTHONUTF8
- `tests/hermes_cli/test_gateway_runtime_service.py`: end-to-end lock — the real generated .vbs (with the PYTHONUTF8 line) passes `verify_windows_task`
- `tests/tools/test_windows_native_support.py`: the windowless restart overlay carries `PYTHONUTF8 == "1"` (Windows-marked)

## How to Test

1. `.venv/bin/pytest tests/hermes_cli/test_gateway_windows.py tests/hermes_cli/test_gateway_runtime_service.py tests/hermes_cli/test_update_gateway_launcher_refresh.py -q` → 49 passed, 24 skipped (platform-marked) on macOS
2. `.venv/bin/pytest tests/tools/test_windows_native_support.py tests/hermes_cli/test_windows_update_restart_reconciliation.py -q` → 12 passed, 17 skipped
3. `python scrip
